name: SiT-S/2 CFG 0.0 NFE 6 / new target 128
target_path: (1-t)*noise + t*teacher_terminal_latent; t is physical SiT time, not rescaled to the truncated endpoint

sources.target_pairs: User correction: paper basis; Appendix G and I.2.2 specify N=128.
sources.optimization: Paper Appendix G and I.2.2: M=16, K=20, UniPC NFE=200; 33 log-shape points over [-2,2].
sources.aggregation: guided-diffusion/shape_optim256.py averages optimal_log_shapes over K runs; np.random.randint samples with replacement.
sources.teacher_order: guided-diffusion/sample_target/imagenet256.sh invokes sample.py default order=2, time_uniform, lower_order_final, no extra denoise.
sources.cfgs_nfes_history: User requested CFG 0.0 RBF NFE 6 retraining; history size and all existing numerical settings retained.
sources.adams: Paper Section 3.6 and samplers/rbf_solver.py log_shape_max=2; candidate loss and rollout use the same branch.
sources.target_path: Paper Eq.13 target from forward path; SiT ICPlan linear flow alpha=t, sigma=1-t.
sources.seed: Existing user/reference seed=1234; target and resampling inputs will be persisted for reproducibility.
sources.conditioning: SiT paper section 3.3: null-label velocity. Evaluate the null label directly on all four latent channels; do not leave the fourth channel conditional through forward_with_cfg.
sources.new_targets: CPU generator seed 1234: verify and consume the original noise(128,4,32,32) then labels(128) draws; generate the next noise/labels block. Retain original NFE6 replacement indices for all 20 runs.

implementation_notes: Frozen SiT weights; original sample_with_optim loop fits gamma and derives RBF coefficients.
FM adapter changes the integral weight, state update and target path only.
Original Gaussian/Adams branch is applied consistently to candidate loss and rollout.
Keep the original 20 independent runs of logical batch 16 and the mean of optimal_log_shapes.
Teacher sampling batch is measured up to the 128-pair workload; optimizer batch 16 is the paper protocol.
Preparation does not start target generation, shape fitting or an RBF FID sweep.
implementation: Reuse vendor.samplers.rbf_solver.RBFSolver.sample_with_optim unchanged through a minimal FM adapter.
